_comment: The DEFINITION of the production bin grid: the parameters it is derived with, the corpus it is derived from, and a content digest of the result. This file is the single source of those parameters -- helix.data.bins reads its defaults here, and scripts/derive_coeff_bins.py takes its argparse defaults from those, so the numbers live in one place.
name: coeff_bins_d1m_j000000_noisy

corpus._basis_digest_note: Checkable BEFORE deriving, and catches the pre-tau/r1 confusion. It does NOT identify which run: basis_digest hashes the DSP recipe, so every run of a corpus built with one DSP recipe shares it (r2 and this corpus do).

_note: Training is noisy-only, so the grid bins the NOISY coefficients (one bin spans the sub-threshold gap). Derived 2026-10-29 on S3DF milano (job 42397808) from 120 events of coeff_tpc_d1m/j000000 (doraemon_2026_1M_lartpc, events 0-199,999), K=128: no empty bins in any band. Replaces coeff_bins_r2_run0027575715_noisy (r2, wire_test_00_00_02).
